item: The governor's closed windows travel in the diagnostics zip (new collect_perf_windows member), paid for by fewer ticks
refs: R181; Q58 = b; PR #1455 (the rows it carries)
summary: R181 (Q58 = b) waits on a diagnostics zip from a slow-network machine that shows its real best permit count. A window record rides the one tick that closes a window (about one in 160), and the zip kept only the newest ticks (20 in the quick copy, 200 in the whole one), so it showed one window or none, never the staircase of permit counts and rates a pass walked. window_history() reads the log's closed windows (all 5,000 rows it holds, at most 31) into one compact row each (ts, pass_id, permits, permits_next, articles_stored, download_rate_kbps and the window's own fields); the zip gets them as a new collect_perf_windows member: the newest 12 in the quick copy, all in the whole one. Bytes are net-zero by construction and pinned by test on the widest row shape (401 B, 377 B measured in the lab runs) against the least a tick row measured (1,650 B): the quick copy keeps 17 ticks instead of 20 (3 ticks = 4,950 B for 12 windows = 4,812 B) and the whole one 192 instead of 200 (8 ticks = 13,200 B for 31 windows = 12,431 B). All byte figures are from lab logs (the 18 Oct G5 runs, 10,982 tick rows and 8 window rows) and the Lenovo bundle's 330 KB over 200 ticks; none is from a field log. The budget claim still needs an independent re-measure on a real written log (the Export lane, which owns collect_perf).
